excerpt: Plan a Dubai sale of mortgaged property using a current bank liability letter, DLD registration, mortgage release and a clear settlement schedule.
introduction:
A mortgaged Dubai property can be sold through a process that coordinates the lender, buyer, seller and Dubai Land Department (DLD). The outstanding debt and registered mortgage must be addressed as part of the transaction. Start with a current liability letter and agree the settlement and release sequence before promising a completion date.

The exact documents, charges and timing depend on the property and parties. Verify them with the bank, DLD and the relevant developer or trustee for your transaction.
takeaways: Request a dated bank liability or settlement letter and check any early-settlement charges.
DLD describes registering a mortgaged property for sale, then completing the sale after the bank's release letter is submitted.
Agree how debt, sale proceeds, fees and any new buyer mortgage will be handled in writing.

sections.heading: 1. Confirm the debt and the property documents
sections.body:
Ask the lender for a current liability or settlement statement, its validity period, early-settlement terms and the steps needed for a mortgage release. A balance shown on an old statement may differ from the amount required on completion. Check whether other loans or registered interests affect the property.

Gather the title, seller identification, any power of attorney, current service-charge statement and developer clearance requirements. If the property is tenanted, review the lease, deposit and possession terms before promising a vacant handover. Verify the buyer's right to acquire the property.

DLD's [mortgaged property sale service](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/registering-the-sale-of-a-mortgaged-property/) lists a bank liability letter and identification among the required documents. Confirm the current list and process for your transaction.

sections.heading: 2. Agree the sale and settlement sequence
sections.body:
DLD describes a trustee-centre process in which a mortgaged property is registered for sale, the bank indebtedness is addressed and a mortgage release letter is submitted before completion of the sale and any new mortgage procedure. The service page lists manager's cheques allocated to the bank or developer, seller and department for its stated process. Confirm current payment instructions directly with the trustee and lender.

Record the price, deposit, allocation of fees, target dates and what happens if the bank release or buyer financing is delayed. If the buyer also needs a mortgage, coordinate the two lenders and confirm whether the procedures can be completed together. Do not assume every sale follows the same timing.

Use traceable payment arrangements and verify the recipient independently. A deposit or initial reservation is not a completed transfer.

sections.heading: 3. Estimate the cash remaining
sections.body:
Imagine a sale for AED 2,000,000, with an AED 1,100,000 loan settlement, AED 10,000 in assumed bank settlement costs, AED 40,000 selling commission and AED 5,000 in assumed clearance costs. The remaining cash is AED 845,000 before other transaction charges, tax and any adjustments. These example inputs show how the settlement and transfer amounts fit into the overall calculation.

The chart shows the allocation of the sample sale price. This is not profit: calculating profit also requires the original acquisition cost, holding costs and other relevant cash flows. Confirm which fees the seller actually pays under the agreement.

If the debt and costs exceed the sale price, discuss the shortfall and bank requirements before agreeing to a sale. Do not assume the lender will release the mortgage without the required settlement.

chart.note: Sample amounts allocate AED 2,000,000 and exclude other charges and the original purchase cost.

sections.heading: 4. Check the release and transfer fees
sections.body:
DLD's [mortgage release service](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/request-for-mortgage-termination) lists the release process and charges for different channels. Its mortgaged-sale page lists additional procedure and service partner fees. The applicable combination can depend on the transaction and timing, so request one itemised current quote rather than adding figures from several pages without checking for overlap.

Ask the bank about its own early-settlement and administrative charges, and agree which party pays each item. The sale registration amount and a new buyer mortgage, if any, are separate from the seller's outstanding loan.

Retain the bank release letter, receipts and DLD confirmation. Confirm the registered outcome before treating the sale as complete or handing over possession under the agreement.

sections.heading: 5. Plan for tenants and handover
sections.body:
If the apartment is rented, provide the buyer with accurate lease and deposit information and agree how rent paid beyond transfer will be handled. Seek advice about the tenant's rights and notice obligations. A sale does not make a tenant disappear automatically.

After the agreed completion, record keys, access cards, parking and meter readings. Reconcile the sale price, debt settlement and charges with the trustee and lender, and keep copies of the final documents.

For market context, the [Business Bay and Marina area guide](/journal/business-bay-vs-dubai-marina-rental-investment) explains why comparable evidence and building charges matter to a buyer. The process above applies only to the relevant property's current circumstances.

sections.heading: Agree what happens if timing changes
sections.body:
A liability letter can expire, a bank may need more documents or a buyer's financing may take longer than expected. Ask the lender and trustee how to refresh the settlement amount and what notice is needed if the proposed completion date changes. Record the agreed conditions and consequences in the sale documents.

If the buyer pays an amount intended to settle the seller's debt, obtain suitable advice about how the transaction is protected and documented. Confirm payment details directly with the bank or approved transaction channel before transferring funds. Each party should understand when the mortgage release, ownership transfer and possession occur and who holds the evidence.

sections.heading: Discuss the property and current process
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Dubai project collection](/projects?emirate=Dubai) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with the unit, lender and intended sale timing. Request a current market discussion and written service terms.

Confirm the settlement amount, release procedure and official fees with the bank and DLD before signing or arranging payments.
